name: Restore the Pendant Lamps
desc: Rewire and polish the old brass pendant lamps. Warm light over the bar and tables.

name: Box of Pint Glasses
desc: Six more nonic pint glasses on the rack. Fewer trips to the sink when it gets busy.

name: Hand-lettered Chalkboard
desc: A proper chalkboard by the door listing tonight's pours. Draws in passers-by.

name: Brass Drip Tray & Tap Polish
desc: Clean lines, a polished font and a brass drip tray. Better beer quality and spills drain away.

name: Light the Fireplace
desc: Sweep the chimney and keep a turf fire going. Locals linger longer, especially on rainy nights.

name: Crate of Glassware
desc: Twelve more pint glasses. Essential for busy weekend nights.

name: Fresh Paint & Green Tiles
desc: Strip the nicotine-yellow walls. Deep green tiles and cream plaster. The room feels bigger and cleaner.

name: Dartboard & Oche
desc: A proper bristle board in a cabinet, a brass oche line and a lamp. Regulars love a game, and you can play them yourself.

name: Snug Corner Stage
desc: Clear out the junk in the corner and build a low stage with stools for musicians. Unlocks trad sessions, singalongs and band nights.

name: Small Sound System
desc: Two speakers and a little mixing desk. Music nights draw a bigger crowd.

name: Restore the Jukebox
desc: Re-gild the old jukebox by the window and fix its lights and speaker. A glowing centrepiece that lifts the room.

name: Soda Gun
desc: A soda gun behind the bar for Brannock's lemonade. Drivers and families stop in too.

name: Lough Glas Lager Tap
desc: Put a lager on. A chrome font with a two-finger head: pour fast at an angle and straighten near the top.

name: Old Photos of the Town
desc: Frame the old photos from the attic: the hurling team of '59, the harbour in the snow. People stop to look and stay to talk.

name: Hanging Flower Baskets
desc: Baskets of geraniums either side of the door. The street notices.

name: Ballyfinn Whiskey Optic
desc: An optic stand on the bar with a bottle of Ballyfinn 12. A tumbler goes up to the optic for one measure. Whiskey drinkers tip well.

name: Red Fox Ale Hand Pump
desc: A proper beer engine with a turned oak handle. Long steady strokes for a full pint of red ale.

name: Cider and Galagers Zero Taps
desc: Two more fonts: Orchard Gate draught cider and the alcohol-free Galagers Zero. Wider appeal, especially in summer.

name: Python Line Cooler
desc: Chills the beer lines all the way to the font. Colder, crisper pints.

name: Card Reader at the Till
desc: Tap to pay. People round up when it's that easy.

name: Brass Foot Rail
desc: A polished brass rail along the foot of the bar. Somewhere to lean, so people linger.

name: Snug Curtains and Lamps
desc: Heavy velvet curtains and little brass lamps in the snug. The cosiest seats in the house.

name: Under-counter Glass Washer
desc: Washes two glasses at a time at the sink. A lifesaver on a busy night.

name: Glass Shelf Extension
desc: Twelve more glasses and somewhere to put them.

name: Cellar Cooling
desc: A proper cooled cellar. Kegs stay fresh twice as long and pour better.

name: Big Screen for Match Days
desc: A screen over the fireplace for the hurling, the football and the rugby. Unlocks match days: the place fills and the roar when they score shakes the glasses.

name: A House Bodhrán
desc: A goatskin drum and tipper kept behind the bar. When a session's on you can sit in and keep the beat yourself.

name: Stained-glass Door Panel
desc: A Celtic knot in amber and green glass in the front door. Lovely in the evening light.

name: Gold-leaf Signwriting
desc: The pub's name re-done in gold leaf over the door by the last signwriter in the county.

name: Beer Garden Out Back
desc: Clear the yard, lay flags, put out benches and heaters. Room for the overflow on a good night.

name: Function Room Upstairs
desc: Open up the old function room for christenings, wakes and the GAA dinner dance. Live nights pull far bigger crowds.

name: Snug Booths
desc: Two high-backed oak booths along the wall, each with its own table and lamp. More seats, and the kind of corner people settle into for the night.
